card.text: Explore Thalassa through its Voyager-derived shape model.

introduction.text: Thalassa is a small, unusually flattened moon close to Neptune. Voyager 2 barely resolved its disk; this view shows its measured shape with a grid where surface imagery is unavailable.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: Shape estimated from Voyager images with motion blur. No reliable surface map is available; gray grid: no imagery.
